paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the initial and final accuracy of a model with respect to o_pop frequency. The x-axis is labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)", featuring a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19 with numerical tick labels placed at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 0.2. The background includes a light gray dashed grid. The line representing "Initial Accuracy" is solid green, features square markers with black outlines, and includes vertical error bars at each data point. This line begins at x=1 with a y-value of approximately 0.34, rises to a local peak of roughly 0.49 at x=5, declines to its lowest plotted point of about 0.30 at x=7, and then climbs to its maximum value of approximately 0.53 at x=13. Following this peak, the values decrease and fluctuate, ending at roughly 0.41 at x=19. The line representing "Final Accuracy" is dashed blue, utilizes circular markers with black outlines, and also displays vertical error bars. It starts at x=1 with a y-value of approximately 0.65, rises to roughly 0.86 at x=5, and dips to 0.72 at x=7 before reaching its overall peak of approximately 0.92 at x=9. The line then drops to a local minimum of about 0.68 at x=13, rises back up to 0.90 at x=15, declines to 0.82 at x=17, and finishes at an approximate value of 0.90 at x=19.
